deposit.name: uPULLI figure build inputs
deposit.note: Fill doi + base_url at deposit time; fetch_data.py reads them.

training/master_frame_features.csv.description: Training set (8 V. cholerae strains): per-(plate, well, frame) features.

training/wide.parquet.description: Training set pivoted wide to <feature>_t<frame>; labelled via training/layout.csv.

training/layout.csv.description: Training set well -> mutant map (plateId, wellId, mutant).

training/embeddings/cls.npy.description: DINOv2 CLS embeddings for the training set, [nWells, 31, 768] float32.

training/embeddings/patchmean.npy.description: Mean-pooled DINOv2 patch tokens for the training set, [nWells, 31, 768] float32.

training/embeddings/index.csv.description: Row index for the training embedding arrays (row -> plate, well).

reimaging/master_frame_features.csv.description: Reimaging atlas: per-(plate, well, frame) features.

reimaging/collapsedWide.parquet.description: Reimaging atlas pivoted wide to <feature>_t<frame>, joined to the gene index.

reimaging/umapEmbeddings.parquet.description: Reimaging UMAP coordinates over the (n_neighbors, min_dist) grid.

reimaging/geneIndex.csv.description: Reimaging well -> geneLocus / geneName / functional annotation.

reimaging/embeddings/dendroPcaCentroids..description: Per-mutant centroids in embedding-PC space, input to the S7 dendrograms.

reimaging/embeddings/dendroClusterOrder..description: Leaf order + cluster assignment for the embedding-PC dendrogram.

reimaging/reimagingResults_10x.csv.description: Reimaging analysis of record: set membership + phenotype per mutant.

transposons/results_10x.csv.description: Genome-wide screen analysis of record: per-well Peak/Final/Early/Phenotype. These calls selected the reimaging library and are read as given, never recomputed.

transposons/master_frame_features.csv.description: Transposon screen: per-(plate, well, frame) features (trajectories for S4A / S5).

kleb/master_frame_features.csv.description: K. pneumoniae mutant set: per-(plate, well, frame) features (growth filter).

kleb/embeddings/cls.npy.description: DINOv2 CLS embeddings for the K. pneumoniae set.

kleb/embeddings/index.csv.description: Row index for the K. pneumoniae embedding array.

multispecies/embeddings/cls_10X.npy.description: DINOv2 CLS embeddings for the 8-species panel, 10X wells.

multispecies/embeddings/index_10X.csv.description: Row index for the multispecies 10X embedding array.

rnaseq/.description: Directory of per-strain differential-expression tables (<strain>_allGenes.csv) for the Fig 4E biofilm-gene heatmap and the Fig S8B-D volcano plots. Raw sequencing reads are deposited in the NCBI Sequence Read Archive under BioProject PRJNA1513060.

reimaging/thumbnails112/.description: Peak-biofilm-biomass thumbnail pack: one 112px grayscale JPEG per reimaging well, keyed <plate-well>_t<peakFrame>.jpg, plus manifest.csv. Inlined as base64 by the interactive plots.

reimaging/thumbnailsTimelapse/.description: Timelapse thumbnail pack: every frame for 3 representative wells per mutant, 96px grayscale JPEG, keyed <plate-well>_t<frame>.jpg, plus manifest.csv. Used by Interactive Plot 3 (build/IP3_interactiveDendrogramTimelapse.py).

lux/Lum.csv.description: Plate-reader luminescence timecourse (41 hourly timepoints x wells A1..H12) for the PvpsL-lux reporter in WT and the clean-deletion mutants, 251212_lux_37C_Shaking. Paired with lux/OD.csv.

lux/OD.csv.description: Matched optical-density timecourse for lux/Lum.csv (same plate, same 41 timepoints); RLU = Lum/OD per well per timepoint.
